title: Stepper Reflects Progress
description: The four-step indicator down the wizard's left side is a dispatcher's at-a-glance map of where they are — active, done, and upcoming steps need to look distinctly different, and stay accurate through both forward progress and stepping back.
successCondition: Across a full pass through the wizard (route -> package -> pricing -> confirm) and one Back navigation, each step's list item in the numbered stepper carries the correct visual state at every point: the current step shows the active styling (brand-colored border/background), completed earlier steps show the done styling (distinct from both active and upcoming), and not-yet-reached steps show the upcoming/neutral styling — verified by reading the actual class names or computed styles at each of the five wizard positions visited, not just by screenshot comparison.
hints: The three visual states are driven by two booleans per step (active = s === step, done = steps.indexOf(step) > i) inside BookingWizard.tsx — you can derive expected state at each position from that logic.
After clicking Back once from Pricing to Package Details, the Pricing step should revert from 'active' back to 'upcoming', not stay marked 'done'.
